title: "Quick start"
description: "Set a project up and run a first task."
sidebar:
  order: 2
---

Requirements: Git, and at least one of the supported agent CLIs (see
[CLI adapters](/documentation/guides/adapters/)).

Install a release binary on your `PATH` or into a project root (see
[Installing](/documentation/start/installing/)). Versions follow semver; `forgecycle version`
prints the one you have.

```bash
forgecycle init
$EDITOR .forgecycle/config.json
git add .forgecycle .gitignore .claude/skills .agents/skills
git commit -m "Configure ForgeCycle"
forgecycle doctor
forgecycle task run tasks/my-task.md
# or, for a plan too large for one task run:
forgecycle roadmap decompose plans/large-plan.md
$EDITOR tasks/<generated-dir>/decisions.md     # answer every decision up front
forgecycle roadmap questions tasks/<generated-dir>   # optional: find decisions still missing
forgecycle roadmap run tasks/<generated-dir>
```

The target repository must already have at least one commit. Each task run
creates the branch `forgecycle/task/<task-run-id>` and an isolated worktree
under `.forgecycle/worktrees/<task-run-id>`, and stores its state and handoffs
under `.forgecycle/task-runs/<task-run-id>/`. Uncommitted changes in the source
checkout are not copied into that worktree.
